description: This is a Flutter widget source file defining the ProductDetailsScreen class, which constructs the UI for a product details page in an e-commerce app, including images, reviews, related products, and navigation actions.

classes.name: ProductDetailsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays detailed information about a product, including images, description, reviews, and related product suggestions, with conditional bottom bar actions based on product availability.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the product details screen, incorporating app bar, product images, info, related links, reviews, and 'you may also like' products list.
